title: tc-change-summary
description: What changed since last time, one metric per row, each with a trend mark.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

period.description: Small text on the right of the heading, e.g. "This week"

changes.description: The metrics, one row each, in the order given

change.description: What happened, in words, e.g. "Up 6.1% to 18.2K"

tone.description: good: green arrow · bad: red arrow · neutral: gray dash

direction.description: Direction of the arrow – defaults to up for good, down for bad
